Summary: Trackers - Daily Maximum Limit for Connected Device
Description:
Participants:
Tech Lead:

Problem Statement (Who, What, Where, When, Why):
At present, there is a daily maximum limit for members who manually input their tracker measurements; however, this limit does not extend to members who are directly connected to the Modern My Active Health application through their devices. Consequently, this allows some participants to manipulate their challenge entries, giving them an unfair advantage in the rankings while others are competing fairly.

Benefit Hypothesis:
By implementing a daily maximum limit for connected device trackers within the Modern My Active Health application will lead to improved data integrity and user engagement. By capping the amount of data that can be synced each day, we expect to reduce the likelihood of data errors and processing delays, resulting in a more reliable and efficient application experience.

Summary: Pathway Enhancement: Extended Pathway Completion
Description:
Problem Statement (Who, What, Where, When, Why):
Today, once members complete all recommended learning pathways, their pathway effectively ends. This creates a dead-end experience that:Reduces engagement and retention post-completion.Prevents members from deepening or refreshing skills (e.g., content changes, knowledge decay).Blocks motivated learners from exploring adjacent or advanced pathways.Limits our ability to maintain a continuous value cycle and habit loop within the product.

Benefit Hypothesis:
If we offer members clear options to continue after completing all recommended pathways-including:Select a new pathway (recommended, trending, adjacent skills, or role-based), and/orRetake a previously completed pathway (full retake or maintenance mode focused on refreshers and updates),then we will:Increase post-completion engagement (measured by 7/30/60-day return rates and session depth).Improve learning outcomes (knowledge retention, skills validation).Boost content utilization (more pathways started/resumed).Increase satisfaction and perceived value

Summary: Introduce Rewards History to the member
Description:
Participants:
Phalguni, Binit, Rohith, Shikha, Mothi, Mohd Ansari, Ananda, Parthibanand (TMV), Sundar, ArunKumar, Krishnappan, Sridevi, Priya, Eric, Jay Carroll, Cyndi, John, Victoria, Adil, Frank, Srini, Prakash, AnitaTechnical Lead: Mohd AnsariBusiness: Leah Briggs, LynetteLoB: Plus, Achieve, Engage and ElitePlatform: Web, iOS, Android

Business Value:
Members earn and redeem rewards across multiple programs configured by the suppliers. Today members lack a single trustworthy ledger that shows what they have earned, when, from which program, and how/when it was redeemed or adjusted.Introducing a view of ""Rewards History"" including all all transactions like Earnings, Redemptions, Roll over and Expiration will provide user with a complete traceability into all the credit / debit transactionsImprove transparency and trust with members and reduce operational overhead in terms of support calls we get for Rewards History,

In Scope:
SummaryImplement a feature that allows members to view their rewards history from previous years - up to 3 years (assumption based on roll over period - current + previous 2 years). Abhishek: 3 Years is fine.Should we include an ""informational message"" somewhere indicating that only 3 year history (based on completion date is seen)?This will provide a user with insights into activities that earned them specific rewards, helping them track their progress over time and encouraging continued participation.The definition of this feature considers 3 important aspects for a historical reward transaction: What Changed, Who Changed, When it Changed.Who can see 'Rewards History''Rewards History' will be accessible from 'Rewards Drawer'. Only those users that can see 'Rewards Drawer', will be able to see 'Rewards History'What will be included in Rewards History?Orientation:History display will be oriented from a point of view of ""Activities"" and will list all complete activities along with additional information around the transaction.This may need to be relooked at. Current design is showing all activities in chronological order and we need them filtered / sliced by plan year and type .Activity Name:Name of the Activity completedTransaction done by:Relationship Type and Name (First name and Initial of last name will suffice). See mockup for examples.Show ""You"" for the context of logged in user (instead of showig their name)For non family scenarios where member has no associated dependents, the name tag on the transactions can be avoided as each transaction will have the same name.Include additional text ""Agent Assisted"" where applicable (see mockup)Where the transaction was not done by an individual and it is a system activity (like roll over or expiration), just show ""System"" instead of 'Relationship Type and First + Last Name'Rewards EarnedQuantity of rewards earnedCurrency Used (Hearts / Points/ Custom / Dollar etc. as configured)Dollar valueShow a dollar value where conversion to $ appliesEligible redemption type tied to this earning:Gift Card / HRA / HSA / HIC/ Reward Dollars/ <Custom>Good to have - The tag for redemption type is needed when you are looking at the comprehensive view but when viewing this history from inside a goal (tied to a single redemption type), all transactions will have the same value. We can hide the tag in this view. Good to have and not a necessary requirement.Transaction DateSee mockups for the formatRewards RedeemedQuantity of rewards redeemedCurrency Used (Hearts / Points/ Custom / Dollar etc. as configured)Redemption type ('Gift Card' alone)All other redemption types are reporting only and we keep accumulating hearts/balance until the end of the year and which ware periodically reported to employer. There is no redemption or feedback loop. No use case to show redemption or deposits in account for such transactions.Consider linking to gift card ""Order History"" where applicable.Rewards Rolled overRollover balance will not show up strictly in the history section but will show up under ""Funds for gift cards"" section of the gift card goal (only one gift card goal possible)Rewards ExpiredQuantity of rewards expiredCurrency Used (Hearts / Points/ Custom / Dollar etc. as configured)Current mockup doesn't include it? Do we need an entry? This however can only be seen at overall level and doesn't make sense when filtered for a specific goal. Additional UI interactions:Filters - Good to have and depending on how UI design works.Goal nameTransaction Date RangeTransaction done by (Member / Dependent Name)Transaction Type (Earning / Redemption) SortingNewest - Show transactions in descending order based on ""Transaction Date"" - Last transaction to be seen on topReward Type - Ascending Alphabetical (A to Z) orderPlan Year - Descending (recent /current year at the top)Pagination:Depending on the UI design, allow for pagination. Default number of records per page to be defined based on App / Web Specific Cases / Informational Messages:Certain activities may not earn rewards until you have completed all the related activities - This is to avoid confusion around Gatekeeper activities , parent / child , multi instance activities etc. Do we show such activities based on current design? Will they not show a heart value or dollar value? Need to determine the exact treatment of such itemsCompletion of 3rd party activities (completed outside of this platform) like 'Annual Physical' are tracked using claims data and may not show up here until the claims are processed. Exact text to be defined by business.Any other relevant information that needs to be shown always or conditionally? Abhishek: NoSupport different programs - Hearts/Points dollar based and Completion basedProgram / Supplier change scenarios:Plan Sponsor Change - if a member moves under a new plan sponsor (employment change), the rewards history from previous plan sponsor should not be visible anymore and history shall be fetched and displayed only from current plan sponsor.Program ID Change while the Plan sponsor remains the same -Program Dates Change while the Plan sponsor remains the same -Supplier ID Change within the same Plan Sponsor - Activities completed while a previous supplier was in effect but was processed and incentivized under a new supplier id - Digital vs External activities??Family Scenario:In case of family, every member can see rewards history for the entire family (same information). This is a continuation of rewards drawer experience. This will be extended to the Rewards history as well.Additional requirements covered under ""Transaction done by:"" section above UX Design: My Active Health UX - Figma Questions:Configurability and Limitations:Which variants will this feature be applicable for? Abhishek: Plus, Achieve, Engage and Elite.Do we need to tie up the availability or visibility of ""Rewards History"" as a configuration at Variant, Program or Supplier level in COP? Abhishek: Make this configurable to be turned on or off at supplier level (COP) for all the 4 variants mentioned aboveAny other limitations or restrictions (apart from this which is covered above - ""Only those users that can see 'Rewards Drawer', will be able to see 'Rewards History')? Abhishek: Can't think of anyWhat is the level of client commitment? Abhishek: High importance. Not sure of the exact client list and if there are specifics around that commitment which are not covered here. Need to also consider the opportunity cost as this will need to be worked by Nottingham, mostly. Do we need to include ""Completion"" only suppliers? Abhishek: Yes, we shall keep it for completion only as well as hybrid situations (where we have completion + other reward type)What would be the behavior for hybrid setup where user have both completion based and redeemable currency based goals and earnings?. Abhishek: See above point. Needed for hybridWhat happens when the currency is changed by the client to some other currency time? How does it impact Rewards History? Abhishek: Show some indicator to mention that rewards configuration changed. We can show basic details as a transaction and ask the member to contact ""Benefit Manager"" for details. Include, basic like - currency change and effective date of the change.What happens if INCV = TRUE but Rewards is not yet setup? Safe to say history will not be shown until you are able to see the drawer? Abhishek: YesShikha: How to treat Migration upon renewal for showing the rewards history? Will it suffice to just show the amount that ""rolled over"" from on prem to modern upon migration? Abhishek: Yes, treat it as a standard rollover. Don't need to mention Platform details.Shikha: Let's include Family Max capability as well to display in incentive history as This applies for all redemption types. Do we need to consider anything else apart from what is already covered above? Abhishek: No. We have covered the need.Shikha: If program ends, renews again with 1 year gap -Then we need to display incentive history (considering # of years) Abhishek: We will show the history. Summary: Agent-assisted gift card redemption - Update Member's Address and Contact info
Description:
Problem Statement (Who, What, Where, When, Why):
Engagement Specialists (ES) lack the tools to efficiently support members during gift card redemptions. For a population that is not digitally savvy and might not have digital devices, email address and phone numbers ES might want to help them update their information on the call. To enhance the holistic experience for our members and improve the efficiency of Engagement Specialists (ES), we aim to implement a system that allows ES to update multiple or alternate addresses and email addresses without OTP verification. Additionally, providing easy access to previous conversation notes will enable ES to deliver accurate information and maintain continuity in support. These improvements will optimize call time and elevate overall member satisfaction.

Benefit Hypothesis:
Allowing members to update their addresses, email id and phone number will enhance their experience, particularly for those who frequently relocate, ultimately increasing member satisfaction and retention. Additionally, by implementing a dedicated ticket search capability, we hypothesize that ES will be able to access ticket information more efficiently, leading to quicker resolutions and improved communication with members.

Summary: MAH, Medquery, LCC metrics on IMT
Description:
Participants:
Soumya, Ravi, Ray, Ananda, Prakash, Junaid, Shenyan, Lynette, Abhishek, Jeniffer D, Imisa, Rohith, Sridevi, Scott, Jordan, Deepak, Chris V, Sundar, Arun, Mrudala, ShankarRTE/DL: Terri Arens

Background:
The Intelligent Monitoring Tool (IMT) is a multi-product platform used by the Business Operations monitoring team to track 12 product lines through real-time Day-over-Day monitoring of member lives in a program and ensure business flow completed end to end for every client. It runs backend queries, populates unified user interface, and triggers configurable threshold-based alerts at three severity levels - so monitors see issues the moment they cross business thresholds. The goal is to reduce monitoring time by 30% while onboarding seven additional products onto the monitoring team - without adding headcount.

Business Value:
Onboard MAH, LCC, and MedQuery to the Intelligent Monitoring Tool (IMT) to deliver a single, real-time, business-KPI view of program health across the member journey - ingestion -> member match -> engagement -> egress -> outcomes - enabling proactive issue detection where traditional observability or application monitoring stops at system health.Operational efficiency: Reduce manual monitoring effort (currently 2.5-3 hrs/analyst); enable 1 analyst to cover all 3 programs in the same window.Proactive detection: Day-over-Day, Week-over-Week, Month-over-Month threshold alerting replaces reactive triage with early warning on ingestion gaps, member-match shortfalls, engagement dips, and outcome trend shifts.Welcome Season readiness: Validates client/member flow, eligibility, entitlement, and program activation end-to-end before campaigns go live.Business KPI lens: ""Observability detects system failures. IMT detects business failures - even when systems look healthy.""

In Scope:
Onboarding the KPI topics from the MAH / MQ / LCC Monitoring Plan to IMT. Only topic categories are listed here, topics are Cross-Program (MAH + LCC + MedQuery) Data Integrity - Vendor/client claim feeds, client enrollment, member entitlement, covered lives, client implementations, variant setup, effective/expiration dates. Member Match - Members by marker, members by condition, entitled members compared to EPIC (clinical system) outreach.EDI / Egress - SFMC email, SFMC text, Surescripts (prescriber), and Arana (print vendor) member counts by program and client.Outcomes - Count of members by open/closed GAP indicator by client (cross-program signal monitoring).Product teams (MAH, LCC, MedQuery) build their own queries / SQL and deliver outputs to IMT; IMT is the platform enabler.MAH-Specific TopicsData Integrity / Welcome Letters - Welcome Letters vs. entitlement, monthly Welcome Letter percent change.Engagement - Engaged (registered) members by client; entitled vs. engaged % by client. EDI / Egress - Egressed incentive files to clients.Outcomes - Incentives by client and by campaign.LCC-Specific TopicsMember Match - Members by AHI (Active Health Index, stratified H/M/L) by client.Engagement - Entitled / Reached / Not Reached and % Reached by client; member counts by appointment status; % appointments completed by client.EDI / Egress - Medica entitlement data by condition (and tobacco).MedQuery-Specific TopicsMember Match - Members by GAP stratification (Severity 1, 2, 3) by client.Engagement / Care Gaps - Members by Care GAPs identified (total and by client); % reminders for open GAPs (vs. 30/60/90-day trigger reports).Outcomes - Missing disposition data (""unknown outcome"") by vendor, client, and GAP / Care Consideration.CTP / ECHO platform - IMT tracks key metrics tracked by CTP and ECHO.

Out of Scope:
# Members in TMV (MML_011) - Descoped per 6/8 confirmation; not used for billing. DataMart / reporting-layer monitoring - IMT sources as close to system of record as possible; not a replacement for aggregated DataMart reporting.Historical data persistence inside IMT - Month-over-month snapshots must be persisted upstream by source/DDAT teams.Member-level case management / remediation - Case-level resolution remains in Care Engine, EPIC, and downstream tools.UX analytics / system observability tooling - Amplitude, Splunk, and similar remain separate; IMT focuses on business KPIs.Drill-down visualizations - Per 6/22 workshop, drill-down views are not KPIs and will not be tracked as measurable metrics.Success Criteria and Metrics Delivery All in-scope KPI topics (Data Integrity, Member Match, Engagement, EDI/Egress, Outcomes) onboarded across MAH, LCC, MedQuery by 7/30/2026. Requirements lock by 7/6/2026; no scope change without formal CR thereafter. 100% of in-scope KPIs traceable from Monitoring Plan -> BRD -> IMT configuration with documented source, frequency, threshold, owner. Engineering build complete with QA query validation green before UAT promotion. Adoption & Operational 1 monitoring analyst able to cover all 3 programs within the 2.5-3 hr daily window. Manual GCP-query / Excel / VLOOKUP effort for daily monitoring reduced by ≥ 70%. ≥ 90% of business KPI questions answered via IMT (dashboards + IMT ADE) without ad-hoc analyst pulls. Quality & Accuracy Maroon-level alert false-positive rate < 5% after 30-day tuning. Business Outcomes Welcome Season: 100% of expected clients/members validated end-to-end (ingest -> match -> outreach -> engagement) via IMT before campaigns go live. Mean Time to Detect upstream feed failures reduced from ""next-day discovery"" to within the SOB window. Member match rates and care gap identification trends visible Day-1 with DoD / WoW / MoM cadence.

Assumptions:
MVP delivery is the target for the 8/30/2026 go-live; enhancements continue iteratively post-go-live. ----
